messages:
eva (pm): FYI: we're publishing an internal playbook to transition projects from the legacy sync SDKs to the modern async SDKs. This thread collects signals, dates, and owners. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're tracking an action.

omar (eng): Link? I want to check impact on shared libraries.

eva (pm): Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/legacy-sync-migration-playbook. Short bullets: 90-day guidance for teams, codemods + compat shim at 30 days, CI lint rollout at 120 days, full archive at 365 days.

claire (docs): We'll write a concise migration one-pager and a few language-specific examples. Plan: publish draft migration guide (py/js/rust snippets) in 5 business days.

sam (sre): We'll run an org-wide usage scan and build a dashboard. Need a compatibility matrix from eng listing supported model formats for the shim.

ton i (devex): +1 for the codemod. I'll own the JS/TS jscodeshift and a Python libcst recipe. We'll publish the codemod repo and a ready-to-run GH Action.

infra-bot: Started scan: legacy-sdk-usage-scan for orgs: redwood-core, partnerA, internal-tools. Progress: 3/10 orgs scanned.

omar (eng): For Dedicated/private customers: we should offer an extended migration window on request. Some customers have embedded the sync bindings into product builds.

eva (pm): Agreed. Policy: 12 months general sunset, case-by-case extensions for private deployments. Security/legal will review exception requests.

claire (docs): Draft banner suggestion: "Notice: The legacy sync SDKs are scheduled for migration. See our migration playbook for steps and tools." Will include a small before/after diff and a checklist.

toni (devex): Compat shim design: provide a thin `redwood-compat` package that maps the old sync surface onto the async runtime using thread executors where needed. Feature-flagged and telemetry-disabled-by-default for privacy.

omar (eng): Can we add a kill-switch env var and server-side feature flag? Some orgs will want to opt-out entirely.

ton i (devex): Yes: REDWOOD_COMPAT_ENABLED + org-level server-side switch. Default off.

sam (sre): Telemetry plan: aggregate counts only, per-org, opt-outable. No request bodies, retention 30 days. Security approved pending legal signoff.

eva (pm): Owners & next steps:
- omar: shim + compatibility matrix (30 days)
- toni: codemods and GH Action (30 days)
- claire: migration guide + banners (5 days)
- sam: dashboard + scans (2 weeks)

docs-bot: Created pages: /docs/migration/legacy-sync-playbook and /docs/announcements/legacy-sync-transition.

claire (docs): I'll also add a short FAQ for Private/Dedicated customers with instruction on requesting an extension.

eva (pm): Weekly sync starts next Thursday 9am PT to review progress. Please add blockers to the RFC tracker before then. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
